naati.title: NAATI Certified Translations
naati.whatItIsParagraph: Professional certified Spanish to English translations for migration, legal, academic, and official purposes across Australia.

whatItIsItems.label: Visa & immigration documents:
whatItIsItems.text: supporting evidence and personal documents for Department of Home Affairs applications

whatItIsItems.label: Academic documents:
whatItIsItems.text: transcripts, diplomas, and qualifications for study or skills assessment

whatItIsItems.label: Legal & official documents:
whatItIsItems.text: contracts, payslips, employment contracts, and other official paperwork.

naati.whoIsItForParagraph: Migrants and visa applicants, international students, skilled professionals seeking qualification recognition, and anyone who needs an official Spanish document accepted by an Australian authority, institution, entity or employer.
naati.whyItMattersParagraph1: NAATI (National Accreditation Authority for Translators and Interpreters) is Australia's national certification body for language professionals. NAATI-certified translations are widely recognised and accepted by the Department of Home Affairs, universities, professional bodies, government agencies, employers, and other organisations across Australia.
naati.whyItMattersParagraph2: Whether you are applying for a visa, enrolling in studies, registering a qualification, or completing an official process, a certified translation helps ensure your documents meet Australian requirements and that your information is communicated accurately, clearly, and professionally.

localisation.title: Localisation
localisation.whatItIsParagraph: Localisation means adapting your message to your audience's context. I adjust your content so it is not only accurate, but also respects cultural nuances and keeps the exact tone your audience needs to hear.
localisation.whoIsItForParagraph: Brands, agencies, businesses and entities looking to communicate successfully in both English and Spanish.
localisation.whyItMattersParagraph: A literal translation can be correct and still fail to convey the right message. Tone, humour, idioms and cultural references do not always translate well, and a misstep can confuse your audience or damage your brand's credibility. Good localisation creates a real connection, so your message is understood as it was intended for each audience.

proofreading.title: Proofreading
proofreading.whatItIsParagraph: A thorough review of your texts or translations that adjusts tone, flow and consistency, catching nuances that automated checkers overlook.
proofreading.whoIsItForParagraph: Individuals, students, businesses and fellow translators who need their final document to be flawless.
proofreading.whyItMattersParagraph1: A good review does much more than correcting errors: it protects your credibility.
proofreading.whyItMattersParagraph2: A single overlooked error in an important document can change its meaning, affect the reader's confidence or even cause the rejection of a process. A final professional review gives you the confidence that your document is ready to be read or published.
